checks: In [0,2]^n×K all 3^n integer fibers have volume a. A parity class with s even coordinates has 2^s equally weighted bases and exactly one reflected partner for each. Its central midpoint probability is 2^s/2^(2s), including the singleton case. The original class mass 2^s a makes its output mass a on the central fiber.

Domination of each class by Lebesgue measure on the actual central fiber of volume a then forces equality of measures on that fiber. Summing exactly 2^n copies verifies the claimed density without any assumption about which conditional continuous coupling was chosen.

For the cap example the endpoint hull has bases 0,1,2 and the intermediate Minkowski body is positive and odd. In the even class exactly three ordered pair types land in z≥1, giving mass (2Ab+b²)/(A+b). Dividing by b gives (2A+b)/(A+b), tending to two as b/A→0. Homothetic endpoint bodies of those volumes exist in every d≥1.
